title: Auto-Drafting Police Reports from Noisy ASR Outputs: A Trust-Centered LLM Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigated and evaluated through a human-in-the-loop system design that forces users (police officers) to review, manually edit specific 'INSERT' statements, and sign off on the draft before submission, preventing over-reliance on the LLM's automated outputs.

Evaluated via a double-blind study where 24 experts, selected for their background in law enforcement equity and inclusion, rated the generated police reports on metrics including 'neutrality' and 'objectivity' to ensure fairness and the protection of suspect rights.
